overview: Based on the published agenda, the Riverside Fire District Commission was scheduled to hold a regular meeting on November 18, 2026, to consider employment matters for both full-time and part-time personnel through a closed session discussion. The meeting was set to include review of previous meeting minutes and potential personnel-related actions.

agenda.item: Minutes of Previous Meeting(s) - Fire Commission meeting minutes of Tuesday, June 2, 2026
Consideration of Motion to Adjourn to Closed Session Pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes Section 19.85 (1)(c) - Employment, Promotion, Compensation or Performance Evaluation Data
Motion to Reconvene into Open Session and Take Possible Action Regarding Items Discussed in Closed Session

discussions.body: The Commission was scheduled to review and consider the minutes from the Fire Commission meeting held on Tuesday, June 2, 2026.

The Commission was set to adjourn to closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes Section 19.85 (1)(c) to discuss employment matters for the Riverside Fire District. The closed session was expected to address consideration of employment, promotion, compensation, or performance evaluation data for both full-time and part-time personnel.

discussions.item: Possible Action on Closed Session Items
discussions.body: Following the closed session discussion, the Commission was scheduled to reconvene in open session and consider taking possible action regarding items discussed in the closed session.
